children: ended its lending activity for Leopold Aschenbrenner’s hedge fund Situational Awareness after the investor suffered severe losses in July.

JPMorgan was one of the prime lenders to Situational Awareness through its prime brokerage. After the losses were disclosed, the bank informed the hedge fund that it would terminate their lending relationship, according to a  Financial Times report on Friday, which cited people familiar with the matter.
JPMorgan and Situational Awareness declined to comment to the FT.
Situational Awareness has recently started working with specialist brokerage Clear Street, according to the report. Clear Street declined to comment to the FT.
The news comes after CNBC reported earlier Friday that Situational Awareness, the artificial-intelligence-focused hedge fund founded by former OpenAI researcher Aschenbrenner, is again

params.linkText: active in the markets through call option buying.

, Bloom Energy (BE), Coreweave (CRWV), SK Hynix (SKHY), and Sandisk (SNDK), CNBC's David Faber reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter. The moves were made last week and early this week.
